subject: Final weave: client immersion day — presenter scripts & travel buffer plan
messages:
From: Alyssa Torres <alyssa.torres@orioncorp.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: orion-corp-events@orioncorp.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Draft agenda + one ask on timing

Hi Logan / Vanessa —

Thanks for sending the initial run-of-show. A couple quick asks from our side as we lock travel: can we please confirm a 30-minute buffer between the last internal prep and client arrival? Two of our execs land later and need a little breathing room to join. Also, would you be able to share speaker scripts or talking points — we're happy to align on wording for the opening and the breakout transitions.

I attached our attendee arrival spreadsheet (small updates). If you want, I can loop in our logistics vendor to confirm shuttles.

Best,
Alyssa Torres
Director, Strategic Programs
Orion Corp

Attachments: arrival-sheet.csv (spreadsheet stub)

From: logan_wright@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Torres <alyssa.torres@orioncorp.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft agenda + one ask on timing

Alyssa —

Great, thanks for the heads up. Short answers up front: yes on the 30-minute buffer; we've built a 45-minute contingency into the arrival window to account for flights and customs. I'll attach a revised agenda (v4) with that buffer flagged.

On scripts: attached is a first-pass "Presenter Scripts v1" focused on the opening, the two breakout transitions, and a 10-minute executive Q&A template. Can Vanessa and Irene skim sections marked [ACTION: ORION REVIEW] and flag any phrasing you'd prefer we adjust?

Logistics plan (high level):
- Shuttle windows: 12:00–13:00 / 16:30–17:30 (we'll confirm exact vendor pickup once you OK the times)
- Green room: reserved adjacent to main room; monitors + direct AV link for remote participants
- Onsite contact: Marcus (venue ops) — cc'ed on the vendor thread once you approve

Next steps / asks: 
1) Alyssa — confirm the two execs' landing ETAs and any VIP dietary notes.
2) Vanessa — please review speaker scripts and drop comments by EOD Wed so I can iterate for Thurs deck freeze.
3) Irene — can you validate the AV cue on slide 12 (video intro) — I noted a 10s fade but we can extend to 20s if it helps pacing.

Thanks — I'll push a v4 agenda and the travel matrix to the shared drive after your replies.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Program Lead, Customer Workshops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Orion-Immersion-Day-Agenda-v4.pdf; Presenter-Scripts-v1.docx; Travel-Lane-Matrix.xlsx

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: logan_wright@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft agenda + one ask on timing

Quick notes —

I reviewed Presenter-Scripts-v1 and left inline comments in the doc for the opening and the breakout handoff. High level: keep the opening tighter (we should be under 8 min), and for breakout B I'd prefer the transition to include the explicit call-to-action "identify top 2 blockers" so the facilitators have a concrete deliverable.

AV on slide 12: Irene, I agree with Logan — extend the fade to 18s and put a one-line caption that introduces the video (helps the late joiners).

Travel matrix: I tweaked the shuttle windows slightly to 12:15–13:15 / 16:45–17:45 to give 15m slack for boarding. Also added a VIP shuttle for Alyssa's execs to ensure no crossover with the group bus.

I'm happy to surface these in the v4 deck if Logan wants to hand off the update.

V.
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Events Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Presenter-Scripts-v1-comments.docx

From: logan_wright@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Torres <alyssa.torres@orioncorp.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Final weave: client immersion day — presenter scripts & travel buffer plan

Thanks everyone — quick final note and next steps so we have a single source of truth before deck freeze Thursday morning.

What I changed (v4 -> final):
- Agenda: built-in 30-minute arrival buffer + 15-minute extra contingency before opening remarks
- Presenter scripts: tightened opening to 7:30 and added the CTA for breakout B to call out "top 2 blockers" (per Vanessa)
- AV: slide 12 video fade set to 18s with caption line; tech rehearsal on Thursday 08:30
- Travel: shuttle windows now 12:15–13:15 and 16:45–17:45; VIP shuttle reserved for Orion execs

Deliverables (who owns what):
- Logan: push final Agenda v5 to the drive and lock the deck for edits (complete) — link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/Orion/immersion-day/v5
- Vanessa: finalize speaker comment resolution in Presenter-Scripts-v1 and upload final scripts (ETA Thu 09:00)
- Irene: confirm AV cue and run tech rehearsal Thu 08:30 (please confirm when done)
- Marissa: coordinate onsite signage and ensure green room door signage matches VIP list (ETA Thu midday)

Alyssa — once you confirm exec ETAs and any dietary restrictions I will forward the final travel matrix to the vendor and cc Marcus at the venue. If all looks good we'll be set for Friday on-site.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Program Lead, Customer Workshops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Orion-Immersion-Day-Agenda-v5.pdf; Presenter-Scripts-v1-final.docx; Travel-Lane-Matrix-final.xlsx
